entities.summary: Wei-Chung Wang is a Taiwanese professional baseball pitcher for the TSG Hawks of Taiwan's Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL). He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Milwaukee Brewers, Oakland Athletics, and Pittsburgh Pirates, in the KBO League for the NC Dinos, and in the CPBL for the Wei Chuan Dragons.
